architecture-core.decision: How the single script is structured: enumerate/extract/resolve-and-check as three functions, no shared state, no configuration.

code-implementation.decision: Source of coding-rule truth, PowerShell 7 stack specifics, zero-dependency policy, and reviewer host/authorization setup.

skipped.component-design: Single-script CLI with three functions in one file; nothing beyond what architecture-core already covers.
skipped.requirements-nfr: No NFR surface beyond what is already pinned as a constraint (zero dependencies, zero false positives on a clean folder); nothing left to decide.
skipped.ui-ux: No UI; explicitly out of scope.
skipped.security-compliance: No auth, secrets, PII, or compliance surface; reads local Markdown files only.
skipped.data-storage: No persistent/durable state; reads the filesystem it is pointed at and writes nothing.
skipped.integration-api: No external services or APIs; HTTP links are explicitly out of scope.
skipped.devops-operations: No deployment, CI/CD, or release change; CI integration is explicitly out of scope.
skipped.observability-resilience: No performance/scale or resilience concerns for a local, single-run CLI over a documentation folder.
